fullName: truck-junction-web-automation:cypress/e2e/seo/CategoryPages/SeoStructureGvw.cy.js#SEO structure - CategoryPages [scv] [en] — SCV TC-SEOS-01: heading structure on SCV [en] matches the stored snapshot
description:
**Test Case ID:** TC-SEOS-01
**Title:** Heading structure on SCV [en] matches the stored snapshot
**Language:** en

**Description:**
Open SCV (en) and compare live SEO headings with the snapshot. Allure and artifacts/seo-structure-report.xlsx show expected vs actual so a changed heading can be copied into test data after it is confirmed.

**Expected Result:**
Every stored heading on SCV (en) is still present with the same tag. Extra or missing headings fail the check; order on the page may differ.

**Steps:**
1. Open SCV (en)
2. Expand Read More if the About block is collapsed
3. Compare live headings with the stored snapshot
